explanation: It is highest at D1: 10 when the agent has recently been choosing a2, and 8-9 when it has been choosing a1. At GO it is about 8 for an a2 choice and 6-7 for an a1 choice, about 2-3 lower right after an unrewarded trial (around 4-5); at D2 it is low and depends on the state reached: 4-5 for S1 after a2 (rare), 2-3 for S1 after a1 (common), 1-2 for S2 after a2 (common) and 0 for S2 after a1 (rare).
